name: build-pack
description: Author, transition, implement, and refactor-before-handoff strategic build packs through approved, rolling slices with durable history and delegated execution.

interface.shortDescription: Author, transition, and implement strategic build packs through approved rolling slices.
interface.longDescription: Create, audit, or transition a durable strategic build pack, preserve completed packs as clearly subordinate history, then lead implementation one human-approved slice at a time with stable slice plans, GitHub issue tracking, right-sized delegated execution, and a human-only merge gate for main.
defaultPrompt: Use $create-build-pack to author a strategic build pack.
Use $implement-build-pack to propose or resume one implementation slice from the active strategic build pack.
Use $refactor-before-handoff to make this passing change maintainable before the PR.
